needsVsWantsItems.title: Monthly Dorm Rent / Shared Accommodation
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Shelter is an indisputable primary human need. Keeping a stable living environment ensures academic focus and safety.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Living with roommates helps divide utility and internet bills.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Daily Specialty Café Caramel Macchiato
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Caffeine is nice, but $5.50 espresso drinks are a luxury Want. You can brew coffee in a dorm mug for under $0.40.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Buying this every weekday costs nearly $110/month!

needsVsWantsItems.title: Semester Core Engineering / Math Textbook
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Required course learning material directly impacts your academic grades and degree completion.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Check if the university library has reserve copies or buy used from seniors.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Premium Multi-Platform 4K Video Streaming Bundle
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Entertainment is good for mental breaks, but top-tier 4K streaming is a discretionary Want. Standard or student plans work just as well.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Take turns with campus housemates or look for university-sponsored entertainment perks.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Monthly Public Bus / Subway Student Transit Card
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Commuting to classes, exam halls, and internship sites is an essential obligation.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Many universities offer subsidized transit passes through student union cards.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Limited Edition Designer Sneakers
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Footwear for protection is a need, but expensive collectors' sneakers are a luxury want.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Delay this purchase using a dedicated savings milestone rather than regular allowance.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Essential Prescription Medication & Allergy Pills
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Health and physical well-being always take top priority in your budget.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Check for generic medicine equivalents or student wellness center clinic dispensaries.

needsVsWantsItems.title: Video Game Battle Pass & In-Game Weapon Skins
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: In-game cosmetics have no real-world utility and represent impulsive discretionary spending.
needsVsWantsItems.tip: Tip: Never spend grocery or book money on virtual items.
